mindfulness.evidence: Goyal et al. (2014, JAMA Internal Medicine, PMID: 24395196): Meta-analysis of 47 RCTs with 3,515 participants showed mindfulness meditation had moderate evidence for improving anxiety (effect size 0.38), depression (0.30), and pain (0.33).

instructions: Close eyes or soft gaze downward
Focus attention on breath (nostril sensation, chest rise, belly expansion)
When mind wanders (it will), gently note 'thinking' and return to breath
No judgment. The noticing IS the practice
Same as beginner, but extend duration
Add body scan: systematically notice sensations from feet to head
Bring gentle curiosity to each sensation
Practice non-reactivity to pleasant and unpleasant sensations
Open monitoring: observe all sensations, thoughts, emotions without attachment
Maintain equanimity regardless of experience quality

vipassana.description: Traditional Buddhist insight meditation technique, widely taught in India through S.N. Goenka centers (free 10-day courses across India: dhamma.org).
vipassana.method: Focus on body sensations with equanimity (non-reaction). Involves systematic scanning of body from head to feet and back.
vipassana.course: 10-day silent residential course - intense but transformative for many. Free of charge (donation-based).
vipassana.availability_india: Multiple centers across India (Igatpuri, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Bangalore, Delhi, Chennai, and more)

transcendental.description: Mantra-based meditation technique (20 min, 2x/day). Uses a personalized mantra assigned by a certified teacher.
transcendental.evidence: Brook et al. (2013, Hypertension): Reduces blood pressure, anxiety, PTSD symptoms.
transcendental.availability_india: Requires certified teacher (paid course: ~INR 35,000-50,000 in India)
transcendental.note: More expensive than other techniques; some evidence of efficacy but comparable results possible with free mindfulness practices.

yoga_nidra.description: Guided relaxation technique, lying in Shavasana (corpse pose). 20-45 minute sessions.
yoga_nidra.claim: 30 min Yoga Nidra is equivalent to ~2-3 hours of sleep in terms of restorative effect (anecdotal; limited controlled evidence)
benefits: Excellent for Indian professionals with high-stress jobs

pmr.name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation (Jacobson's Technique)
pmr.evidence: Manzoni et al. (2008, PMID: 18752854): Meta-analysis showed significant anxiety reduction.
steps: Lie down or sit comfortably. Work through each muscle group:
1. Right foot: Tense for 5 sec, Release for 30 sec
4. Left foot, calf, thigh: Tense each, Release
7. Chest: Inhale deeply and hold, Exhale and release
8. Right hand (make fist), forearm, upper arm: Tense each, Release
9. Left hand, forearm, upper arm: Tense each, Release
13. Full body: Tense everything, Release, Notice the wave of relaxation

indian_context_stressors.stressor: Long commutes (1-3 hours daily in metros)
solutions: Use commute for audiobooks, podcasts, breathing exercises (box breathing in traffic)
Negotiate 2 work-from-home days if possible
Practice mindfulness during commute instead of doom-scrolling

indian_context_stressors.stressor: Work-life boundary blur (WhatsApp work groups, post-hours calls)
solutions: Set boundaries: mute work groups after 8 PM
Communicate availability hours clearly to team
Create physical separation between work and personal space
Set realistic expectations with family through open communication
Therapy is increasingly normalized in urban India
Use free counseling services (iCall, Vandrevala Foundation)

indian_context_stressors.prevalence: ~70% of young professionals report financial stress
solutions: Create a budget using the 50/30/20 rule
Build emergency fund equal to 6 months expenses
Use financial apps: ET Money, Groww for investment tracking
Digital detox: no screens 1 hour before bed
Unfollow accounts that trigger comparison
Practice gratitude journaling
Limit social media to specific times of day

indian_context_stressors.prevalence: Seasonal and chronic in major metros
solutions: Wear N95 masks outdoors on high AQI days
Use air purifier indoors (especially bedroom)
Exercise indoors when AQI >150
Keep indoor plants that filter air (money plant, spider plant, areca palm)

indian_context_stressors.stressor: Toxic work culture (Indian IT, startup hustle)
indian_context_stressors.prevalence: Common in IT sector and startups
solutions: Set non-negotiable health boundaries: 7+ hours sleep, 30 min exercise daily
These are health investments, not luxuries
Document overwork patterns; discuss with HR if systemic
Consider job change if culture is irredeemable
Open communication about boundaries and expectations
Couples counseling if needed
Many Indian therapists are trained specifically in family dynamics
Practice assertiveness while maintaining respect

exercise_for_stress.mechanism: Increases GABA, reduces cortisol, improves HRV
Rhythmic breathing + exercise creates a meditative state
Social + exercise + music = multiple stress-relieving modalities

caution: Very high-intensity exercise (marathon training, CrossFit to failure) can INCREASE cortisol and stress in chronically stressed individuals. Moderate intensity is optimal for stress reduction.

breathing_review.author: Zaccaro et al.
breathing_review.finding: Systematic review showed slow breathing techniques reduce anxiety, improve HRV, and modulate autonomic nervous system

mindfulness_meta.author: Goyal et al.
mindfulness_meta.finding: 47 RCTs showed moderate evidence for improving anxiety, depression, and pain
